crossRefs.note: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.
Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized, and was praying. The sky was opened,

parallels.note: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.
Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Nazareth
people.line: The hometown of Jesus in Galilee

translations.web: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
translations.bsb: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
translations.asv: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in the Jordan.
